title: Assertions for extension from a finite disjoint union of opens
statement: Let k be algebraically closed and f:X → Spec k a reduced curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting]. Let Λ be a finite commutative coefficient ring, r prime, and F a constructible module-valued etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] killed by r. For n pairwise disjoint opens U_a, put W = union U_a. The eight conditional assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for extension by zero of F restricted to W are equivalent to all eight assertions for each extension by zero of F restricted to U_a [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Neither density nor irreducibility is assumed; n = 0 is allowed.

proof.text: Define G_a=j_a! j_a* F. The curve X is Noetherian, so each open immersion j_a is quasi-compact. Constructibility of inverse image and of open extension by zero with the scheme-theoretic closed complement give constructibility of G_a. The composite additive functor j_a* followed by j_a! sends r times the identity of F to r times the identity of G_a, so each G_a is killed by r.
Apply the proved disjoint-open biproduct decomposition to obtain e:j_W! j_W* F ≅ ⨁_a G_a.
Apply the general common-prime biproduct assertion equivalence to f, r, the constructible r-killed family G, and e. Its two sides are definitionally the desired assertions.

proof_origin.place: 03SC proof, fourth paragraph, and 0A5C; geometric biproduct decomposition proved in Lean by T2, analytic finite-sum comparison isolated in lem-pbc-t2-prime-biproduct-assertions.

theorem assertions_iff_disjoint_open_prime (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (r : ℕ) [Fact r.Prime] (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] (hF : r • 𝟙 F = 0)
    (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → X.Opens)
    (hU : Pairwise (fun a b ↦ Disjoint (U a : Set X) (U b))) :
    IsCurve.Assertions Λ f
      (((⨆ a, U a).ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
        (((⨆ a, U a).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)) ↔
      ∀ a, IsCurve.Assertions Λ f
        (((U a).ι)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj
          (((U a).ι)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F))
